items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle sprain), questionable, is expected to play vs Chargers.
items.why: Sources confirm expectation after limited practice
items.implication: Rookie shares or leads backfield; monitor snap share vs Allgeier
items.opportunity: If limited, Tyler Allgeier benefits; otherwise Love goal-line/early-down upside

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain), listed questionable after full participation late in week, is not expected to play vs Lions.
items.why: Not quite ready despite full practices
items.implication: Saints backfield opens fully for Travis Etienne and depth
items.opportunity: Etienne lead role, possible Kendre Miller/Estime shares; pass-game boost to Olave

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf), questionable, is expected to go vs Panthers.
items.implication: Maintains perimeter role alongside Burden/Swift; full targets available
items.opportunity: Route share intact; reverse any Burden/Loveland beneficiary assumptions if active

items.text: Levitan: Less than 24 hours from lock; very important player-specific discussions happening in ETR Slack today (context on clearances, GL, docks).
items.implication: Final docks and opportunity adjustments locked soon

items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers questionable (knee); team elevated Braxton Berrios and signed Dalen Cambre from PS.
items.why: Knee recovery from prior ACL; elevations signal contingency
items.implication: Monitor inactive; if out, Fields/Mooney/Berrios targets rise; Likely TE bump per Berry
items.opportunity: If limited/out: Malachi Fields, Isaiah Likely usage spike

items.text: Patriots officially placed WR A.J. Brown on injured reserve.
items.implication: NE WR corps thins; long-term absence
items.opportunity: Elevates other NE pass-catchers and Maye checkdowns

items.text: Falcons QB Cooper Rush (back spasms Sat) will still start Sunday at PIT; Tua Tagovailoa OUT (oblique).
items.why: Team confirmation despite spasms; Tua ruled out earlier
items.implication: ATL offense under Rush; lower ceiling than Tua but functional
items.opportunity: London/Pitts usage stable or elevated in short-passing

items.text: Cowboys placed RB Malik Davis on IR and signed Israel Abanikanda from practice squad.
items.implication: DAL RB depth thins behind Javonte Williams

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace: NO @ DET up in pace; MIA @ LV slow-paced slog. Saints/Cowboys expected fast overall.
items.why: Neutral pace projections and game environment
items.implication: Higher play volume for DET/NO skill players; lower for MIA/LV
items.opportunity: Gibbs every-down potential in track meet; Jeanty still viable despite slow

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers ruled OUT (meniscus trim procedure), expected to miss 1-2 weeks.
items.implication: Michael Mayer becomes primary TE target; Jeanty pace/usage bump possible in pass game
items.opportunity: Mayer 20%+ target share potential; Raiders pass-catchers elevate

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (ankle) full participant all week, no designation, cleared and expected heavy workload without Bowers.
items.implication: Feature back in LV offense missing Bowers
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share; pass-game upside as checkdown

items.text: Raiders DE Maxx Crosby will play today, ending offseason trade rollercoaster; shut down Rams interest after failed Ravens deal.
items.implication: LV defense full strength vs MIA; impacts game script/pace
items.opportunity: Slight negative for MIA offense volume

items.text: Berry keeping it open on Chuba Hubbard as viable flex this week (The Chubbler).
items.why: Viable flex despite committee noise with Brooks

items.text: Berry contrarian: CMC usage concerns and Kaelon Black looks overblown (preseason bang-up, long flight, weird game); CMC is a BUY LOW.
items.why: Context of limited sample and travel/fatigue

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Isaiah Likely ranks 4th in TE fantasy PPG/target last 3 yrs; Nabers won't be 100%; gimme all the Likely (Fields/Mooney as WR2).
items.why: Target efficiency + Nabers limitation + thin WR room
items.implication: Likely TE streamer/start upside if Nabers limited

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Saquon Barkley averages 136.5 rush yds/6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in 4 games vs WAS (incl playoffs); WAS front still below avg.
Berry 10 Facts: Olave 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% games with Shough last year; Lions safeties on IR; high O/U.
items.why: Chemistry + matchup + volume environment (esp if Kamara out)
items.opportunity: High target share in up-tempo game

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Parker Washington 24% target share when 70%+ routes; 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share; Browns CB Ward on Brian Thomas.
items.opportunity: Primary target when running full routes
